First test release of the native Snatcher (Sega CD, US) port - a static recompilation, no emulator. Work in progress.

**The game is not included.** Put your own Snatcher disc image (US release T-95035, the .cue and its .bin files) next to the program or in the `game` folder, or drag the .cue onto the program.

Downloads:
- Windows: `snatcher-*-win64.zip` - unzip and run `snatcher.exe`
- Linux / SteamOS (Steam Deck): `snatcher-*-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` - extract and run `./snatcher`; on Steam Deck add it as a Non-Steam Game for Game Mode

Controls: arrows / d-pad move, C or Space (controller A) select, X (controller B) cancel, Z (controller X) Blaster, Enter / Start, F11 fullscreen.

Saves go to `snatcher.brm` next to the disc image.

Known issues:
- A white box can flicker in the text window on some dialogue screens (seen on the Katrina screen)
- Settings menu not done yet

Please report anything that looks or sounds different from the original, with a screenshot and roughly where in the game it happened. A `snatcher.brm` save from just before the problem helps a lot.
